consequence.statement: This bugfix accepts a 'v'-prefixed Bottlerocket alias that was not allowed before. Nothing in an existing configuration stops working.

assertion.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 fixes a bug so that Bottlerocket aliases can now use a "v" prefix.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence only says 'bottlerocket aliases'. It does not name the resource kind, API group or field path that carries the alias, and there is no artifact context to confirm the spelling.; applicability: Without the exact field path of the alias, I can't write a predicate for where it is set. The evidence also doesn't show the alias format that was rejected before.
